user.title: New curtain
user.description: Pick the curtain that gets solar control. Each curtain becomes its own device.

discovery_confirm.title: Curtain found
discovery_confirm.description: Found **{name}** (`{entity_id}`). Set up solar control for it?

geometry.title: Installation geometry
geometry.description: Dimensions in centimeters, measured from the floor. Sun is assumed to enter on the curtain side and only then reach the door.

data_description.facade_azimuth: Compass direction the facade faces: 0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west.
data_description.max_incidence: For grazing sun beyond this angle from the facade normal, the sun does not close the curtain.
data_description.roll_center_height: Height of the roll center with the curtain 100% open.
data_description.edge_to_roll_open: Distance from the bottom edge to the roll center with the curtain 100% open.
data_description.edge_to_floor_closed: Distance from the bottom edge to the floor with the curtain at 0% (closed).
data_description.beam_height: Height of the beam underside: the upper limit of the opening the sun comes through.

sensors.title: Sensors and horizon
sensors.description: All optional. Sensors left empty are no longer required by the decision.

data_description.horizon: Azimuth:elevation points of the building top, separated by semicolons. E.g. 262:15; 291:15 (top at 15° between 262° and 291°). Outside the points there is no obstruction.

error.invalid_geometry: Inconsistent dimensions: the beam must be above the closed edge and not above the open edge, and distances must be positive.
error.invalid_horizon: Invalid format. Use azimuth:elevation pairs separated by semicolons, with at least two points.

abort.already_configured: This curtain already has solar control.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this curtain is already in progress.
abort.no_covers: There are no cover entities left without solar control.
